steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace/logs 2>/dev/null || ls -la /app/logs 2>/dev/null || pwd && ls -la
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
head -5 /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_api.log
echo ---
head -5 /workspace/logs/2025-07-03_db.log
echo ---
grep -oE 'ERROR|WARNING|INFO' /workspace/logs/2025-08-12_api.log | sort | uniq -c
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta
logdir='/workspace/logs'
today=date(2025,8,12)
periods={
 'today':(today,today),
 'last_7_days':(today-timedelta(days=6),today),
 'last_30_days':(today-timedelta(days=29),today),
 'month_to_date':(today.replace(day=1),today),
}
sev=['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']
counts={p:{s:0 for s in sev} for p in list(periods)+['total']}
for fn in os.listdir(logdir):
    m=re.match(r'^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_.*\.log$',fn)
    if not m: continue
    d=date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    local={s:0 for s in sev}
    with open(os.path.join(logdir,fn),errors='replace') as f:
        for line in f:
            mm=re.search(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]',line)
            if mm: local[mm.group(1)]+=1
    for p,(a,b) in periods.items():
        if a<=d<=b:
            for s in sev: counts[p][s]+=local[s]
    for s in sev: counts['total'][s]+=local[s]
out='/workspace/summary.csv'
with open(out,'w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['period','severity','count'])
    for p in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total']:
        for s in sev:
            w.writerow([p,s,counts[p][s]])
print(open(out).read())
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -l /workspace/summary.csv
echo "independent total:"
grep -rhoE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' /workspace/logs | sort | uniq -c
EOF
